backend/main.mo: Motoko actor defining booking system with TripType variants (airportTransfer, byTheHour, pointToPoint), fare calculation logic, and CRUD operations for bookings stored in a Map.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting the replacement of location references with updated Indian state names in LocationInput.tsx component.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-formatted summaries of all frontend files including pages, components, hooks, and configuration files for the Yuvashri Travels booking application.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light and dark themes using OKLCH color space, defining design tokens for backgrounds, borders, and UI elements.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the Yuvashri Travels React application with root div and module script reference.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component configuring TanStack Router with routes for booking and confirmation pages, wrapped in ThemeProvider and QueryClientProvider with Toaster for notifications.
frontend/src/components/BookingForm.tsx: Main booking form component managing state for trip details, integrating fare calculation hook, form validation, and submission with navigation to confirmation page.
frontend/src/components/BookingHeader.ts: Sticky header component displaying Yuvashri Travels logo and branding with backdrop blur effect.
frontend/src/components/DateTimePicker.t: Reusable date/time input component with calendar/clock icons, validation for minimum dates, and required field support.
frontend/src/components/FareEstimate.tsx: Card component displaying calculated fare estimate with Indian Rupee symbol, loading spinner during calculation, and disclaimer text.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component with copyright notice and attribution link to caffeine.ai with UTM tracking parameters.
frontend/src/components/LocationInput.ts: Select dropdown component for choosing Indian states and union territories (36 locations) with MapPin icon, replacing previous text input for pickup and drop locations.
frontend/src/components/TripTypeSelector: Tab-based selector for choosing between three trip types (One-Way, Round Trip, Local Rental) with icons and active state styling.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook that manages the backend actor instance using React Query, creating authenticated or anonymous actors based on Internet Identity state and invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useFareCalculation.ts: React hook that calculates trip fares by calling the backend actor with trip details (type, locations, duration), debouncing calculations by 500ms and validating required fields based on trip type.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: React context provider and hook for Internet Identity authentication, managing login/logout state, identity persistence, and delegation validity with configurable AuthClient options.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: React Query mutation hook for creating bookings via the backend actor, accepting trip parameters and invalidating the bookings query cache on success.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom design tokens defining a professional teal/blue color scheme for light and dark modes, including primary, secondary, accent, and semantic colors.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query and Internet Identity providers, then renders the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/BookingConfirmationPa: Confirmation page that displays booking details after successful creation, fetching booking data by ID from the backend and showing trip type, locations, schedule, and fare information.
frontend/src/pages/BookingPage.tsx: Main booking page with a hero section featuring a background image and headline, followed by the BookingForm component for creating new cab bookings.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the default theme with custom colors using OKLCH color space, container settings, border radius variables, animations, and typography/container-queries plugins.
project_state.json: Project state tracking file for a Yuvashri Travels taxi booking page with 10 existing features including trip type selection, location inputs, date/time pickers, fare calculation, and branding. Contains pending feature requests for backend data models, booking history, and admin dashboard functionality.
